en: Wait, Himiko...what do you mean <CLT=cltSTRONG>one arrow<CLT=cltNORMAL>?

Nyeh? Well, I only gave Kaito
one arrow, so...
<CLT=cltMIND>...What?
Are you positive?

Of course! There's no way
I got that wrong!
Well then, that's strange because...

...there were <CLT=cltSTRONG>three arrows<CLT=cltNORMAL> in the bathroom,
remember?
Nyeh!? Three!? I know I only gave him one!

Kaito even told me to only bring him one. 
He said he wanted to avoid fighting.

<CLT=cltMIND>There were three arrows at the scene,
but Himiko said that she only brought one.
<CLT=cltMIND>What is going on here?

Umm... Maybe Kokichi had some
hidden away?

Why would Kokichi have two arrows when he
didn't have a crossbow to fire them?

But we know for certain that three arrows
were recovered from the scene...
...and all three arrows had blood on them.

And altogether, their clothes had three
perforations in them.

So we know for certain that they shot
three arrows at each other...

<CLT=cltMIND>Then where did those arrows come from?
I don't think that Himiko is lying...

<CLT=cltMIND>There must be some angle to this
we haven't considered yet...

<CLT=cltMIND>What is it...?
What could have happened?
<CLT=cltMIND>Think!
<CLT=cltMIND>I need to think!
